text: Review: Anyone who wants braces, I recommend choosing a good clinic. I've had braces for almost 7 years and paid too much. The staff didn't inform me of anything. I was very confused. When the payment was too much, they just put a pin in instead! And I wasted my life waiting in line. I went to get it done once and waited 2-3 hours. The doctor said he would come at noon. The patient arrived at noon and the doctor arrived at 12:30. I don't understand why they had to make an appointment so early. Even though there was a queue, I still didn't get my turn. The management is terrible.

The doctor is lovely and has gentle hands. The staff are very nice and made me feel less worried. I'm usually afraid of needles and going to the doctor, but when I came across this place, it opened my eyes to the world. Thank you very much …

I do not recommend coming here. It's a waste of time waiting. Appointments are made in advance, but you never get your dental work done on time; they're often 2-3 hours late. The scheduling system is terrible. It's a waste of time, your time is stolen, and they don't respect other people's time. They need to improve.

1. The place is clean.
2. Short wait time.
3. Good service, very welcoming staff.
The dental work here is great; the dentist is very gentle.
